arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Sums the transaction amounts, in dollars, for all transactions on cards whose credit limit is above $20,000.
assumptions: Credit limit above $20,000 means credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000 (20,000 dollars in cents).
The total includes all transactions regardless of label status, and includes negative amounts as recorded.
No date filter is applied, so the total covers the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
